elon-universe.name: Elon Musk
elon-universe.bio: Leads Tesla and SpaceX, the businesses behind electric vehicles, reusable rockets and Starlink. He has led Tesla since 2008 and founded SpaceX in 2002.

pelosi-disclosed-equity.name: Nancy Pelosi
pelosi-disclosed-equity.role: Former Speaker of the US House
pelosi-disclosed-equity.bio: The first woman elected Speaker of the US House of Representatives, serving two separate terms. Her household’s public financial disclosures, primarily involving Paul Pelosi, are closely watched by investors.

berkshire-disclosed-equities.name: Warren Buffett
berkshire-disclosed-equities.bio: Built Berkshire Hathaway into a diversified investment and operating-business group over six decades. Buffett remains chairman; Greg Abel succeeded him as CEO in January 2026.

trump-universe.name: Donald Trump
trump-universe.bio: A real-estate businessman who became the 45th and 47th president of the United States. This portfolio follows a CRE8-selected investment theme around his public disclosures and associated businesses.

dan-bin-oriental-harbor.name: Dan Bin 但斌
dan-bin-oriental-harbor.bio: Founded Shenzhen-based Oriental Harbor in 2004. The Chinese investment manager and author of The Rose of Time is known for his long-term approach to owning businesses.

ray-dalio-bridgewater.name: Ray Dalio
ray-dalio-bridgewater.bio: Founded Bridgewater Associates in 1975 and helped establish institutional global-macro investing. His economic frameworks shaped the firm’s approach; its disclosed holdings represent Bridgewater, rather than his personal account.

bill-ackman-pershing.name: Bill Ackman
bill-ackman-pershing.bio: Founded Pershing Square, known for concentrated ownership of major businesses and shareholder activism. Its core portfolio typically holds just eight to twelve companies, giving each investment substantial influence.

bill-gates-foundation.name: Bill Gates
bill-gates-foundation.bio: Co-founded Microsoft in 1975 and chairs the Gates Foundation, a major global-health and development organization. The holdings tracked here belong to the Foundation Trust, rather than his personal investment account.

cathie-wood-arkk.name: Cathie Wood
cathie-wood-arkk.bio: Founded ARK Invest in 2014 after decades in thematic investing. She leads its research and investment approach to disruptive innovation, spanning technologies such as AI, robotics and genomic medicine.

tom-lee-granny-shots.name: Tom Lee
tom-lee-granny-shots.bio: A former JPMorgan chief equity strategist and co-founder of Fundstrat. He leads GRNY’s Granny Shots strategy, selecting companies that connect to multiple investment themes.

dan-ives-ai.name: Dan Ives
dan-ives-ai.bio: A prominent technology analyst and former global head of technology research at Wedbush. His AI research framework underpins the IVES ETF’s selection of companies across the AI economy.

stanley-druckenmiller-duquesne.name: Stanley Druckenmiller
stanley-druckenmiller-duquesne.bio: Founded Duquesne Capital in 1981 and later managed money for George Soros. His career spans macroeconomic positioning and concentrated equity investing; this selection tracks disclosed Duquesne holdings.

ken-griffin-citadel.name: Ken Griffin
ken-griffin-citadel.bio: Founded Citadel in 1990 after beginning to invest from his Harvard dorm room. He built an institutional investment business and also founded the separate market-making firm Citadel Securities.

serenity-x.name: Serenity
serenity-x.bio: Publishes research on the physical supply chain behind AI, including photonics, optical networking and memory. The account connects technical industry developments with publicly listed companies across global markets.

raoul-pal-x.name: Raoul Pal
raoul-pal-x.bio: Co-founded Real Vision and founded Global Macro Investor. A former Goldman Sachs and GLG professional, he connects macroeconomic cycles, liquidity and technology adoption with digital-asset markets.

ansem-x.name: Ansem
ansem-x.bio: A widely followed voice in crypto, especially Solana and onchain market rotations. His public posts cover market sentiment, token narratives and his own stated trading decisions.

ming-chi-kuo-x.name: Ming-Chi Kuo 郭明錤
ming-chi-kuo-x.bio: A technology analyst known for research on Apple’s supply chain and product roadmap. His public work follows component suppliers, manufacturing developments and the wider AI infrastructure industry.

herman-jin-x.name: Herman Jin
herman-jin-x.bio: A former Goldman Sachs FICC executive and founder of Zen Family Office. His public commentary brings institutional macro experience to semiconductors, AI infrastructure and digital assets.

chris-lee-x.name: Chris Lee
chris-lee-x.bio: A former OKEx CEO who later joined Huobi’s leadership. He shares views on AI, semiconductors and digital assets from personal, family-office and fund portfolios, which may hold different positions.

jim-cramer-x.name: Jim Cramer
jim-cramer-x.role: CNBC host & former hedge fund manager
jim-cramer-x.bio: Hosts CNBC’s Mad Money and co-anchors Squawk on the Street. A former hedge fund manager and founder of TheStreet, he also leads CNBC Investing Club, making him one of US financial television’s best-known stock commentators.

peter-schiff-euro-pacific.name: Peter Schiff
peter-schiff-euro-pacific.bio: An economist, bestselling author and founder of SchiffGold, known for his commentary on gold, inflation and global markets. This model follows the supported selection from Euro Pacific Asset Management’s institutional filings.

jeffrey-gundlach-doubleline.name: Jeffrey Gundlach
jeffrey-gundlach-doubleline.bio: Co-founded DoubleLine in 2009 and leads the investment firm as CEO and CIO. Known for fixed-income and macro investing, his public market commentary is widely followed. This model covers DoubleLine ETF Adviser’s disclosed equity sleeve.

gavin-baker-atreides.name: Gavin Baker
gavin-baker-atreides.bio: Managing partner and chief investment officer of Atreides Management, an investment firm focused on technology and consumer businesses. He founded Atreides in 2019; its public filings provide a view into its AI and technology investments.

david-einhorn-dme.name: David Einhorn
david-einhorn-dme.bio: Co-founded Greenlight Capital in 1996 and built a long-short, value-oriented investing career. He is also the author of Fooling Some of the People All of the Time. This model uses DME Capital’s disclosed supported holdings.

lyn-alden-x.name: Lyn Alden
lyn-alden-x.bio: Founded Lyn Alden Investment Strategy in 2016, combining engineering and finance to research monetary systems, energy and global markets. She wrote Broken Money and is a general partner at Ego Death Capital.

leopold-aschenbrenner-situational.name: Leopold Aschenbrenner
leopold-aschenbrenner-situational.bio: Founded Situational Awareness in 2024 after working at OpenAI. With a background in mathematics, statistics and economics, he researches how AI development reshapes technology, energy and global businesses, translating that work into an AI-focused investment strategy.
